rawEvidenceNote: This published artifact is a per-failure summary, not a TAP/stack/diff evidence bundle. Original TAP identities and terminal counts are retained below. Full local classification and original logs remain preserved separately.
method: Match relative file plus exact test name. Inspect underlying import exception, not test-failed wrapper. Normalize repository prefixes and random rebuild-directory names only. Never subtract failure totals to infer regressions.
limitations: All original failures remain failures. Applicability classification is not a waiver or PASS.
File-level import aborts conceal assertions and account for different total reported test counts. Baseline-only masked failures are not repairs.
The R35 direct comparison is the six failing files (83 tests), not a claim that the entire direct suite ran at R35.
No old test, fixture, source-restoration helper or production file was changed by this triage.
The initial be5b668 run predates the helicopter hotfix. Final 88d5db6 logs are a separate phase; this artifact never promotes initial counts to final acceptance.
CPU tests do not establish browser rendering, actual native input, GPU performance or historical/measurement accuracy.
